countryMotifPolicy.flagMotifDecision: Montenegro's flag emblem is official heraldry and is not copied. No literal flag appears.
countryMotifPolicy.palette: Montenegro red and gold with black-mountain, Adriatic blue, pale limestone, and silver transition accents.
fallbackMotifs: Kotor Bay contours, black-mountain silhouettes, old-city wall merlons, and limestone window arcs
Durmitor peak facets, Black Lake rings, pine silhouettes, and glacial-ripple geometry
Budva carnival masks, red-tile roof fans, Adriatic dance ribbons, and stone-arch geometry
Durdevica Tara Bridge trusses, Tara River meanders, canyon strata, and carved maple rosettes
countryMotifPolicy.minimumCoverage: Every scene uses large complete secular Montenegro motifs across at least two character outfits, readable as full bodice, skirt, shorts, jacket, or footwear constructions rather than tiny accents.
countryMotifPolicy.cultureScene: Scene 1170 foregrounds secular Budva carnival and Adriatic nightlife design through large complete mask and dance-ribbon motifs without copied ceremonial dress.
countryMotifPolicy.prohibitions: No literal flag, coat of arms, official eagle, sacred symbol, political insignia, copied ceremonial dress, official badge, or branded product.

anatomyGate.automaticRejects: Reject any extra, duplicated, floating, fused, borrowed, emerging, hidden-owner, or ambiguous limb or finger cluster, malformed face, incomplete shoe, or untraceable contact.
